title: Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis: Ranking Candidate Drivers by Convergent Cross-Method Evidence from Observational Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.20187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practitioners inferring causality from observational data usually rely on a single method and treat its output as causal truth. Recent tools select an optimal method for a dataset, and recent ensembles aggregate multiple causal-discovery algorithms into one graph, but little work pools evidence across different mathematical traditions, including non-causal ones. We present Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES), a framework that ranks which candidate drivers in an observational system are most likely relevant to a set of outcomes, and with what strength of evidence. MCES runs eleven methods across eight mathematical traditions on observational panel data and pools their outputs into a Convergent Evidence Score (CES), a linear opinion pool. CES quantifies convergence of evidence across analytical lenses: the degree to which methods with different assumptions point to the same driver-outcome relationship. It does not claim causal

translated_title: 多方法因果证据合成：通过观测数据的跨方法收敛证据对候选驱动因素进行排序
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20187v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从业者通常依赖单一方法从观测数据中推断因果关系，并将其输出视为因果真相。近期工具会为数据集选择最优方法，而集成方法则将多个因果发现算法聚合到一个图中，但很少有工作汇集不同数学传统（包括非因果方法）的证据。我们提出了多方法因果证据合成（MCES），这是一个框架，用于对观测系统中哪些候选驱动因素最可能与一组结果相关及其证据强度进行排序。MCES在观测面板数据上运行跨越八个数学传统的十一种方法，并将其输出汇总为收敛证据评分（CES），这是一种线性意见池。CES量化了不同分析视角下证据的收敛性：即具有不同假设的方法指向相同驱动因素-结果关系的程度。它并不声称因果性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多方法因果证据合成框架（MCES），通过融合十一种不同数学传统的方法生成收敛证据评分（CES），以排序观测系统中候选驱动因素与结果相关的证据强度，而非直接断言因果性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis (MCES) framework that pools eleven methods across eight mathematical traditions into a Convergent Evidence Score (CES) to rank candidate drivers by evidence strength for outcomes in observational data, without claiming causality.
